episodes.synopsis: A reincarnated Van trains relentlessly until his powerful magic leads his dismayed father to cast him out.
episodes.title: The Young Genius's Harsh Expulsion From His Home

episodes.synopsis: Van arrives to find his new village under attack, so he defends his people, then plans for their future.
episodes.title: The Proper Way to Use Weak Magic

episodes.synopsis: Van strengthens village defenses as adventurers uncover signs of a nearby dungeon.
episodes.title: The Wonderful Renovation of an Impoverished Frontier

episodes.synopsis: Van's victory is followed by visits from merchants and then an emissary from the neighboring county.
episodes.title: Rushed Hosting and a Busy Emissary Visit

episodes.synopsis: Apkallu appear on the shores of Van's lake and Van gets dragged into a competition with his marriage at stake.
episodes.title: A Rare Species' Passionate Engagement Competition

episodes.synopsis: A forest dragon attacks the village, so Van rallies his forces who fight for the survival of the village.
episodes.title: Slaying a Dangerous Forest Dragon with Large Ballistae

episodes.synopsis: Bell & Rango refuse to let Van be swindled. Panamera visits the capital to secure a title for Van.
episodes.title: Earnest Merchants and Receiving a Proud Title

episodes.synopsis: Ortho's party accidentally discovers the dungeon, forcing them to report it, which attracts wild adventurers.
episodes.title: A Postapocalyptic Band's Rowdy Dungeon Exploration

episodes.synopsis: Arte puts on a dance performance with her marionette magic, and the king visits to see Van's handiwork.
episodes.title: The Timid Girl's Beautiful Marionette Dance

episodes.synopsis: After defending Seatoh Village from the Kingdom of Yelenetta, Van's forces must ride to Scudett's defense.
episodes.title: A Secret Weapon's Villainous Attack on the Homeland

episodes.synopsis: Scuderia's forces carry out the operation to retake Scudett Fortress.
episodes.title: The Ultimate Squad's Proud Counterattack

episodes.synopsis: Arte defends her homeland from Yelenetta Kingdom's assault.
episodes.title: Easygoing Territory Defense by the Optimistic Lord
